issues.problem: Unit error: fiscal 2024 revenue was $391.0 billion, not million.

issues.quote: The bottom line was the standout: net income grew 19.5%
issues.problem: Misleading: fiscal 2024 net income was depressed by a one-time charge of about $10.2B for the EU State Aid tax ruling. Underlying growth was much lower, so this is weak evidence of 'durable earnings leverage'.

data.summary: The figures for revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, EPS, R&D and the margins all match Apple's reported fiscal 2025 and 2024 results. However, fiscal 2024 revenue is wrongly given as $391.0 million instead of billion. The 19.5% net income growth is also inflated by the one-time EU tax charge in fiscal 2024.
